title: Simple Multitools
description: A mod that adds multitools to minecraft.
body:
# Simple Multitools
A mod that adds multitools to minecraft.

 

## Item list:
- Wood Multitool
- Stone Multitool
- Copper Multitool
- Iron Multitool
- Diamond Multitool
- Netherite Multitool
- Infinity Multitool
### Yes, the textures are ugly. I'm a bad drawer.
